Plotly.js 2.27.0 (full minified distribution)
Source: https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js/blob/v2.27.0/dist/plotly.min.js
Plotly license: MIT; see LICENSE-plotly.txt and the retained library header.
Embedded dependency notices: plotly.min.js.LICENSE.txt (assembled from the
upstream unminified distribution and linked license texts; not an upstream
generated file). Keep both notice files when distributing this library.

This copy ships with the application for offline graphing. Do not fetch it at
startup or add a CDN fallback. To update, deliberately replace the library and
notices, update the filename in index.html and sync_bundle.sh, and verify graph
rendering and exports. Run sync_bundle.sh to include these assets in releases.
